NQ.researchNote: HTF FVG plus rejection block followed by a retracement containing another RB has been studied; direct RB entry was discussed as weaker. Validate this against the database before treating it as a rule.

framework: let trade play out in high RR
execution: do not import NQ rules automatically

preTradeChecklist.override: Any killer means NO TRADE regardless of score.

principles: Do not validate hindsight simply because a trade won.
Compare winners and losers under similar conditions.
Do not turn a small sample into a permanent rule.
Preserve the pre-entry decision independently from the final result.
researchMethod.targetStyle: High-RR retracement setups; historical discussions included approximately 1:10 to 1:12 RR targets, but analyze realized data rather than assume those targets are optimal.

observations: A recent loss does not automatically invalidate a setup.
Call out repeated behavioral mistakes only when supported by data.
